Yum. 8/9/2026 Chad P Excellent pizza and service 8/1/2026 Kelie S My company did a catoring order a couple months back and the food was absoluely amazing; my team is still talking about it! They were so happy it wasn't another corporate owned food supplier & were fighting over seconds & thirds. Setting up the catoring was super easy & they delivered right on time with everything we needed. This is a great locally owned spot that has awesome food & service. We will be using them again! 7/28/2026 Kathi J Love their sauce. Reasonably priced lunch. Nice dinning area 7/27/2026 Missy H My brother never disappoints when hosting his parties and serving Pietro’s! I've always been happy with their food and customer service. Be prepared for longer wait times for to-go orders than they tell you on the phone. It's worth the wait and the food is so amazing when fresh and hot out of the oven.
